requests.name: DELETE my account (token only)
requests.testScript:
pw.test("Status is 200", () => { pw.expect(pw.response.status).toBe(200); });
pw.test("success is true", () => { pw.expect(pw.response.body.success).toBe(true); });
requests.description:
Deletes the LOGGED-IN user's own account. Token-only - no id in the URL, no body; the account is taken from the JWT. Soft-deletes the account and revokes all refresh tokens (login is then blocked). Needs any user's Bearer token. After calling this, log the user out client-side (clear the token).

### Expected response (OK 200)

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Your account has been deleted."
}
```

requests.name: DELETE my account · already deleted (404)
requests.description:
Reference: calling delete again (or with a token of an already-deleted account) returns 404.

### Expected response (Not Found 404)

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "message": "Account not found or already deleted.",
  "code": "NOT_FOUND"
}
```
